project_name: Honda Safe Journey - Connected Mobility & Safety Cockpit
theme: Honda Precision Dark Automotive (Honda Signature Red + Dark Obsidian Carbon)
architype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Elite Automotive Athleticism & Precision Safety)
instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST read and strictly adhere to these design guidelines for constructing the Honda Safe Journey application.
This app is a hybrid fullstack connected mobility safety platform for Honda vehicle owners (2-wheelers & 4-wheelers) and Honda Service Center Dealers in India.
Do NOT use generic standard light SaaS styles or default Inter/Roboto fonts for main headings.
Use a high-contrast dark automotive cockpit theme (#090C14 base, #101622 surface, #E60012 Honda Red brand accents, #1E293B border, glowing status indicators).
Ensure ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, toggles, cards, links, modals, tabs) include explicit `data-testid` attributes in kebab-case format.
Ensure Leaflet maps render with dark-mode tile layers (CartoDB Dark Matter) or styled tiles, with smooth custom animated vehicle markers and emergency incident radius overlays.
Every page/screen must feature micro-animations, active status indicators, glowing telemetry chips, and structured visual depth.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or flat white boxes for high-tech automotive UI. Use layered dark cards with 1px subtle borders (border-white/10) and subtle red glow highlights.
Never default to Inter or Roboto for titles. Use Outfit or Barlow Condensed for display headers and JetBrains Mono for telemetry data.
Containers with borders MUST have generous internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent visual overcrowding.
Always set hover text colors explicitly alongside background hover changes (e.g. hover:bg-red-600 hover:text-white).
Include responsive mobile navigation alongside desktop topbar floating controls.
All modals (SOS Alert, Safety Check-in, Claim Filing, Document Settings) must be backdrop-blurred (backdrop-blur-md bg-black/70) with clear action CTAs.
Avoid emoji characters for functional icons. Always use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react icons.

typography.heading_h3: font-display font-semibold tracking-wide text-lg sm:text-xl text-slate-100
typography.telemetry_metric: font-mono font-bold tracking-wider text-xl sm:text-3xl text-red-500
typography.label_overline: font-mono text-xs font-semibold tracking-widest text-red-400/90 uppercase

login_landing.title: Google Login & Role Selection Hub
login_landing.description: Honda Safe Journey landing with dual login options (Rider/Driver vs Honda Dealer Service Center) + Google Auth simulation.
components: Brand Navbar with Honda emblem badge & live safety network counter
Role selection toggle/cards (Vehicle Owner / Rider vs Authorized Honda Service Center Dealer)
Google Auth button with mock profile picker & instant login
Safety Stats Marquee (100% encrypted document vault, 112 VSSR emergency hookup, live telemetry)

onboarding_wizard.title: Vehicle Onboarding Wizard
onboarding_wizard.description: Choice of 2-Wheeler (Activa, Shine, CB350, Transalp, EM1 e:) vs 4-Wheeler (City, Elevate, Amaze, Civic).
components: Vehicle category switcher with rich vector/image cards
Registration & Model detail form (Reg No, Chassis/VIN, Color, Year, Fuel/EV type)
Primary Rider/Driver profile verification step

bluetooth_pairing.title: Simulated Bluetooth Telemetry Sync
bluetooth_pairing.description: Pairs vehicle ECU via BLE simulation, displaying real-time battery/fuel %, range (km), health status.
components: Radar search animation with scanning beam
Connected status badge with signal strength indicator (-65 dBm)
Energy level gauge with animated fuel/battery fill bar & range estimator
Diagnostic checklist (Tire Pressure, ECU Health, Oil/Battery Temperature)

document_wallet.title: Encrypted Document Wallet & Privacy Matrix
document_wallet.description: Store Aadhaar Card, Driving License, Vehicle RC, Insurance Policy, PUC Certificate, and Medical Emergency ID with granular permission toggles.
components: Document grid with badge indicators (Valid, Expiring Soon, Verified)
Per-document permission drawer/switches (Share with Police 112 / Share with Emergency Family / Share with Honda Dealer / Share with Insurer)
Upload/Add Document modal with simulated OCR auto-fill
Security audit log (Who accessed what document & when)

emergency_contacts.title: Emergency Family Network Hub
emergency_contacts.description: Manage trusted contacts for instant SMS/WhatsApp alerts during accident detection or ETA delays.
components: Contact cards with priority tags (Primary Kin, Doctor, Secondary Contact)
Test Alert trigger button to send mock SMS/WhatsApp notification
SOS broadcast preview panel

start_journey_precheck.title: Journey Creator & Readiness Pre-Check
start_journey_precheck.description: Select Origin (Point A) and Destination (Point B), run optional automated safety pre-check before ignition.
components: Location autocomplete / quick presets (Home, Office, Honda Service Station, Highway Hub)
Distance & Estimated Travel Time calculator
Automated Pre-Check modal: checks energy levels (>20%), document validity (RC/Insurance active), BLE connectivity state
Start Safe Journey CTA button with telemetry launch sequence

live_journey_cockpit.title: Live Interactive Navigation & Telemetry Cockpit
live_journey_cockpit.description: Interactive Leaflet dark map with smooth moving vehicle marker, real-time speedometer, ETA ticker, and simulation triggers.
components: CartoDB Dark interactive map with route polyline & live animated marker
Digital instrument cluster: Speed (km/h), Energy %, Distance Traveled/Remaining, ETA
Interactive Simulation Control Bar: [Simulate Route Deviation], [Simulate Traffic Delay], [Simulate Sudden Impact / Crash]
Real-time event feed log

safety_checkin_modal.title: Interactive Safety Check-in & Countdown Modal
safety_checkin_modal.description: Triggered on route deviation or sudden ETA delay. Prompts 'Are you safe?' with a 15-second countdown timer before escalating.
components: Pulsing alert dialog with 15-second countdown ring
'I am Safe - Continue Journey' button (resets system)
'Need Assistance' / 'Trigger Emergency SOS' instant escalation button
Audio beep simulation trigger

sos_emergency_panel.title: 112 VSSR & Family SOS Emergency Control Center
sos_emergency_panel.description: Activated during impact detection or manual SOS press. Transmits Aadhaar + live GPS + vehicle payload to ERSS 112, family members, and nearest Honda dealer.
components: Pulsing red hazard HUD with siren status
Live dispatch summary: Sent to 112 ERSS Command, WhatsApp to 3 Emergency Contacts, SOS ticket logged to Honda Dealer
Aadhaar & Medical ID broadcast data card
Cancel SOS button with PIN / Security override

destination_reached.title: Safe Arrival Confirmation & Trip Summary
destination_reached.description: Generates trip report, automatically fires 'Safely Arrived' notifications to family, and archives safe journey log.
components: Trip summary stats (Total distance, avg speed, eco score, safety score 100%)
Automated notification confirmation toast / status log
One-tap trip closing button

accident_claim_system.title: One-Tap Instant Accident Insurance Claim (FNOL)
accident_claim_system.description: Post-incident or manual trigger to pull documents from Document Wallet (RC, Aadhaar, Policy No, Driver License) and push a prefilled FNOL claim to integrated insurer via API simulation.
components: Auto-assembled Claim Data Package viewer (Telematics speed + Impact G-Force + Location + Wallet Docs)
Integrated Insurer Selector (ICICI Lombard, Bajaj Allianz, HDFC ERGO, Honda Assure)
One-Tap Submit Claim button with real-time API response animation & Claim Reference ID generation

dealer_dashboard.title: Honda Service Center Dealer Command Center
dealer_dashboard.description: Dedicated portal for Honda dealers to monitor active connected vehicles, real-time SOS incidents, incoming crash alerts, remote telemetry diagnostics, and claim approvals.
components: Dealer Topbar with Service Center ID (e.g., Honda Authorized Center - Cyber City Gurgaon)
Active Connected Vehicles Fleet Grid / Table with live telemetry status
SOS Emergency Alert Center with urgent sound indicator & rapid dispatch controls
Vehicle incident timeline viewer + Document audit inspector
Direct vehicle owner call / service dispatch launcher

testing_and_data_attributes.rule: Every button, input, tab, card, and modal action MUST have a data-testid attribute.
